Turquoise Health is a series C HealthTech startup, spread out remotely across the USA.

We are hiring for full time software engineers for our product engineering team to tackle the black hole of what is now America's healthcare revenue cycle. If you are a high performing full stack engineer who can be collaborative, innovative yet operates with no ego then we want you.

Our tech stack here is as follows: Python, Django, FastAPI, React, Typescript, Vue.Js etc
